pages.text: “When the wind rises, seeds drift, take root, and transform into sweetness.”$(br2)Dandelion Tea is a refreshing herbal drink made from sun-dried dandelion flowers. It has a naturally sweet taste and grants travelers a light and swift step, making movement across the land effortless.

$(br2)$(br)Dandelion Tea is simple to prepare—$(br)just blend sun-dried dandelion flowers with sugar to create this fragrant tea.$(br)Perfect for enjoying on a journey, helping travelers move with greater ease.

Upon drinking Dandelion Tea, travelers gain a temporary Speed boost, allowing for faster movement.$(br)This tea is a light and refreshing choice, offering slight assistance for long journeys.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
